_comment: Ten people at once. Every other capability judges ONE arrival; this is what Arun actually experiences — the pile. Does it become one message or ten, does the urgent one lead, does the same thing said twice count twice, and do the ones he never answered come back later without nesting inside each other. All free and deterministic: the ledger and the summariser are pure given a clock.

arrivals.subject: can you approve PR 1409 today?
we are blocked on your sign-off for the booking fix
everyone pls do update your reflection in workday
hi everyone please suggest anything for the sprint demo
FYI - sprint 42 notes, no action needed
Automated: deployment to sit succeeded
Weekly newsletter: platform updates
hi everyone will be away for the rest of the week
everyone preprod will be down for an hour
mentioned you in Daily deployment slot

cases.why: ten arrivals must reach his phone as ONE message. Ten notifications for one poll is the flood he complained about, and it is what makes him stop reading them at all.
cases.source: triage.summarize renders a poll as one message; attention.consider decides what enters it

arrivals.subject: Weekly newsletter: platform updates
hi everyone will be away for the rest of the week
booking-api pods are down in prod
can you approve PR 1409 today?

cases.why: an outage buried under a newsletter is the same as no outage — the pile has to be ordered before it is rendered. Uses 'pods are down', which is already breakage: an error-rate threshold breach is deliberately NOT critical, because it is a warning that may settle and the alert path holds those briefly rather than interrupting him.
cases.source: attention.rank → looks_critical → P_NOW; outlook's alert design separates 'is down' from 'may settle'

cases.why: the feed re-renders the same row every poll — without dedup the pile grows on its own and he is chased about one PR three times
